verified_current_state.product: Shared workspace for a construction company and its client to manage a job site from creation through mutual closure

membership_unique: one active organization membership per user
identity_and_context.account_role_selection: required once before tenant or participant context
identity_and_context.organization_context: derived server-side from the authenticated single active membership

security.iban: AES-256-GCM dedicated application key ring with AAD
security.blob: private, server-mediated, MIME checked, SHA-256, 4 MiB maximum

visual_foundation.typography: General Sans primary and ARRAY accent

interaction_and_curvature_contract.canonical_radius: --radius: 0.625rem; derived sm/md/lg/xl = 6/8/10/14px; semantic pills remain full
interaction_and_curvature_contract.nested_radius: For every nested rounded pair sharing a perceptual corner, R_outer = R_inner + actual inset per corresponding corner; distant descendants are not a concentric pair
interaction_and_curvature_contract.button_link_boundary: Button is command-only and exports only Button; navigation uses a real anchor or router Link through @qoovex/ui/components/link without Button internals
interaction_and_curvature_contract.action_motion: Opaque settled surfaces; centered four-side hover; restrained anisotropic press; immediate independent focus; interruption and rapid input retarget from current position and velocity; reduced motion preserves non-spatial feedback
interaction_and_curvature_contract.icon_button_boundary: IconButton is the canonical stateless icon-only command with required aria-label or aria-labelledby, a stable root/focus owner, separate animated surface and glyph, and a real 44px coarse target; toggle, close and copy use specialized components
interaction_and_curvature_contract.toggle_button_boundary: ToggleButton is the canonical standalone two-state pressed control: Base UI owns state and aria-pressed; the controlled property meaning remains stable; optional pressedContent keeps visible copy, active accessible name, icon and persistent surface synchronized in one stable geometry slot; physical press stays separate; ToggleGroup/Switch/disclosure and opposite-action commands remain separate
interaction_and_curvature_contract.close_button_boundary: CloseButton is the canonical quiet close/dismiss action: internal IconX, fixed 28px visual geometry with 8px radius and 44px coarse target, no inline geometry override, required contextual aria-label or aria-labelledby (including explicit DialogContent closeButtonProps), Action Motion without glyph decoration, consumer-reserved coarse target plus placement offset, and no ownership of dismissal behavior, placement, loading, clear/remove/delete, or Dialog context
interaction_and_curvature_contract.copy_button_boundary: CopyButton is the canonical quiet icon-only clipboard command: stable accessible name, internal idle/copying/success/error lifecycle, simultaneous same-slot Copy-to-Check-or-Error Motion, one live status channel, 1000ms generation-safe hold, no aria-pressed, no copied value in DOM metadata, and no ownership of sensitive or text-action flows

impeccable_quality_layer.authority: mandatory for UI/UX but subordinate to Qoovex canonical sources and real code
impeccable_quality_layer.distribution: reproducible install; .agents/skills/impeccable is ignored and not vendored
impeccable_quality_layer.hook: repository-owned temporary monorepo dispatcher with machine-local session state and local Codex approval

visual_geometry_quality_layer.runtime: Playwright 1.62.0 in pinned Noble image with Chromium, 1440x1000 viewport, DPR 1, it-IT locale and Europe/Rome timezone
visual_geometry_quality_layer.coverage: manifest-governed Sirio, Web and DB-free Workspace states with fail-closed route classification and PR blast radius
visual_geometry_quality_layer.geometry: 0px exact by default; at most 1px only for documented optical relations
visual_geometry_quality_layer.baselines: versioned and isolated by platform and Playwright project; update is local-only with exact attestation and forbidden in CI
visual_geometry_quality_layer.fonts: intentionally excluded from CI assertions; external font loading, identity, integrity, Fontshare assets, document.fonts and font-family are not gated
visual_geometry_quality_layer.database_impact: zero; Workspace uses an inert loopback PostgreSQL target and no database is started or queried

ui_skills_specialist_layer.authority: optional external specialist discovery after Qoovex and Impeccable routing; never a source of truth or release gate
ui_skills_specialist_layer.selection: prefer one specialist, use two for distinct angles, maximum three for broad review/redesign
ui_skills_specialist_layer.impeccable_duplicate: forbidden; use the repository-pinned Impeccable integration
ui_skills_specialist_layer.motion_order: Qoovex protocol -> Impeccable -> qoovex-ux-motion -> optional narrow UI Skills specialist -> minimum sufficient technology -> Impeccable review -> Qoovex gates

mobile_responsive_quality_layer.authority: machine-readable responsive and input-capability contract with deterministic static audit and real-browser coverage
mobile_responsive_quality_layer.runtime_targets: loopback apps and ephemeral *_ci PostgreSQL only; no remote database or Blob target

task_completion_quality_contract.definition_of_done: A repository-changing task is complete only after a focused regression when applicable, all cumulative gates required by the real blast radius pass on the final diff, and required PR checks pass on the same final SHA when PR or push is in scope.
task_completion_quality_contract.failure_policy: A pertinent failure remains in the current task until its root cause and regression are fixed; tests must not be skipped, weakened or disabled to obtain green status. An external or unattestable blocker must be reported as hard_stop with exact evidence.

context_continuity_rule.work_block: Consecutive tasks in one persistent session, on the same domain or responsibility, while relevant canonical sources and decisions remain unchanged.
context_continuity_rule.preflight: Full canonical preflight is required at the start of each work block and repeats when its trust conditions or sensitive boundary change.
context_continuity_rule.micro_task: Reuse verified context but inspect current involved files, impacted consumers, pertinent tests, diff and Git state; reread a previously touched file before modifying it.
context_continuity_rule.foundation_policy: Reuse approved foundation contracts and solutions within the block; correct a failing contract at its source or report the conflict, never add a local workaround.

specialist_gate_applicability.rule: Classify each specialist gate from the real blast radius before execution; execute only applicable gates and retain all required controls.
specialist_gate_applicability.not_applicable: Formal operational classification with a short deterministic reason when a technical schema requires a field; it is not evidence of a specialist review.
specialist_gate_applicability.mcp_schema: No repository-owned MCP or configuration schema was found for the observed write-gate behavior; an external provider must support not_applicable in its own schema rather than requiring a simulated review.

blast_radius_verification_rule.workflow: diff -> real responsibilities and reachable consumers -> applicable gates -> minimum sufficient verification -> reuse prior green evidence with unchanged inputs -> broader work-block or release gate only when required.
blast_radius_verification_rule.evidence_reuse: Green evidence is reusable within a work block only while its inputs, relevant transitive dependencies, shared foundations and blast radius remain unchanged and reliable.
blast_radius_verification_rule.broad_scope: Global tokens, base CSS, theme, public shared UI APIs, widely used primitives and test or gate infrastructure derive broad coverage from real dependency reachability.
blast_radius_verification_rule.ci_release: Agent-local minimum sufficient verification does not change required CI or release checks.

evidence_rules: a changed input invalidates earlier test evidence
failed, pending, skipped or previous-SHA checks are not green
focused tests do not replace cumulative package and cross-consumer gates
ordinary reports and diagnostic screenshots are transient
versioned visual baselines are canonical fixtures and change only after intentional review

approved_product_direction.product_promise: A construction company and its client share the work history, updates, requests, changes, contextual files, decisions and closure of a job site.
approved_product_direction.commercial_model: The company pays; collaborator access is included and invited client access is free. Pricing and billing are not implemented.

conceptual_not_implemented: pricing, plans, trials, limits and billing
in-app payment, escrow, refunds and arbitration
hard_stops: Qoovex does not move, custody or guarantee money
No db push, migrate reset, migrate resolve or manual SQL
No Preview or Production mutation outside guarded workflows with exact target identity
No fallback from the data-encryption key ring to Auth or MFA secrets

historical_immutable.migration_ledger: ops/migration-ledger.json is the sole source for published migration identifiers and checksums.
